KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

2. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

5. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

6. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

7. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mato
   D. kitoto

8. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

9. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.

10. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. fupi
   C. pana
   D. zito
